copy.curiosityHook: Left behind as obsolete, can a solitary veteran hold off the very force designed to replace him when they arrive to wipe out the settlement?
copy.description: Cast out after being defeated by a new generation of genetically engineered warriors, veteran Sergeant Todd is left for dead on a remote waste planet, where he takes shelter among peaceful crash survivors.
copy.vibeSummary: A fast, suspenseful sci-fi action ride with high stakes and moderate emotional weight, ideal for an engaged solo watch.
copy.whyWatch: Paul W. S. Anderson stages a lean, fast-paced science fiction showdown pitting weathered combat experience against ruthless engineered replacements.

allowedMaterial: Sergeant Todd is a veteran soldier replaced by genetically engineered troops
Dumped on a waste planet and presumed dead
The new soldiers arrive to eliminate the colony and he must defend it
excludedMaterial: Survival status of the colony or specific survivors
Todd's ultimate fate or later reversals
